proposed_sites.reason: Module-level assignment to openai.api_key must become explicit client construction, e.g. client = OpenAI(api_key=...)

Namespaced module-level call openai.ChatCompletion.create(...) must become client.chat.completions.create(...) under v1.x; reached via chatcompletion() helper invoked from chat() -> get_response() -> the /get route.

considered_and_rejected.reason: The import itself remains valid in v1.x (the openai module still exists); only the usages below it are broken, so this line's own text does not need to change.

This accesses the ChatCompletion response as a dict, which changes behavior in v1.x (responses become Pydantic objects with attribute access), but it does not match any of the three specified patterns (namespaced call, openai.error.*, or module-level auth assignment), so it is out of scope for this audit.
